description: What each provenance level means and what it can support: connected (Attify pulled every record from the customer's own system), witnessed (the vendor's agent streamed each interaction to Attify as it happened, signed and timestamped; it counts toward a verification only once the customer consented and reconciled it each month) and uploaded (a file, self-reported, never a verification). Also how an agent on its own platform sends witnessed data: the Ingest API, the Python and TypeScript SDKs, or OpenTelemetry, with the endpoints, schema and docs. Give a level to explain one.

level.description: One level; omit for all three.
